acceptanceCriteria: The post-release recovery mode skips source quality, build, candidate acceptance, publish, and publish-side artifact creation when the immutable v0.2.91 Release already exists.
The recovery validates the immutable v0.2.91 tag, Release manifest, asset digests, and execution handoff identity before public acceptance.
Public fresh installation and public N-1 upgrade run in independent isolated environments and consume downloaded public Release artifacts, with the requested tag as their source identity.

Public acceptance and version consistency start only after their required handoff/public identity dependencies succeed; close records structured skipped dependencies and cannot report green closure from a green summary job.
A failed recovery stage resumes from valid persisted evidence without rebuilding, republishing, deleting resources, or rerunning successful stages.
goal: add an explicit post-release acceptance recovery path that reuses valid publication evidence, runs public install and N-1 upgrade in parallel, fails early on invalid inputs, and prevents dependency-failure cascades
intent: complete the already-published v0.2.91 handoff, public acceptance, and governed close without rebuilding or republishing
requiredEvidenceClasses: immutable tag and Release identity receipt

scenarioCoverage.expected: An invalid or incomplete post-release request is rejected during the cheap input preflight before Runtime compilation or release-tool compilation starts.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add a workflow policy regression that checks explicit post-release mode inputs and run the resolver/preflight fixture with missing and mismatched identities.

scenarioCoverage.expected: An existing immutable v0.2.91 Release is verified and reused without rebuilding candidates, creating a Release, moving a tag, or overwriting assets.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add a post-release workflow path and policy assertions proving it has no build/publish dependency and consumes the existing Release manifest, checksum set, and asset identities.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Public fresh installation and v0.2.90 to v0.2.91 upgrade run in independent isolated environments from downloaded public assets and bind the requested Release source identity.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add workflow policy and harness regressions for public-only execution, immutable tag checkout, isolated roots, and parallel acceptance dependencies.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A failed handoff or public acceptance produces structured skipped dependency results and prevents close from claiming green closure.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add job-condition and close-receipt policy assertions for each failed dependency and verify the close barrier remains a reporting failure rather than a second unrelated failure.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Retrying a failed post-release stage reuses still-valid handoff and public identity evidence without repeating successful publication, deleting resources, or rebuilding the Runtime.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add explicit persisted-run input validation and a recovery fixture that asserts stage reuse and identity mismatch fail closed.
